info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Etas-v5-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery ETAs Retrieval API provides access to estimated delivery times for food orders. This endpoint enables clients to query the expected delivery times for various food delivery requests, allowing businesses to manage customer expectations effectively. Common users include food delivery applications and restaurant management systems seeking to enhance user experience through timely updates. By leveraging this API, developers can integrate accurate ETA information into their platforms, improving overall service efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the estimated delivery time for a specific order based on its parameters. It is essential for users to plan their schedules accordingly and ensures timely communications regarding their deliveries.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the estimated time of arrival (ETA) for deliveries. This should include the necessary parameters to calculate the ETA based on the user's input and delivery details.

204.description: The request was successfully processed with no content returned.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesEtasRequest.description: Represents the request body for the GET operation related to deliveries' ETA.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesEtasResponse_2.title: Delivery ETA Response

status.description: Indicates whether the request was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A string representing the unique reference number for the delivery.

resultId.description: A unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the delivery request.

processingTimeMs.description: The processing time of the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesEtasResponse_2.description: This schema represents the response for the Delivery ETA operation, providing status and other relevant information about the request.

AuditInformation.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the delivery entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the delivery entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the delivery entry was created by an automated process.

AuditInformation.description: This schema provides details related to the audit of the delivery operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. A value of 0 indicates that the request was processed almost instantaneously.
